description: Capture a live web page by URL as a PNG screenshot, or as an A4 vector PDF with format "pdf". Returns the rendered image plus a shareable CDN URL; PDF renders return the URL only. Consumes one credit per call.

css.description: Optional CSS to inject into the page before capture.

dpi.description: Scale factor / device pixel ratio (1-4) for higher-resolution output.

format.description: Output format. "png" (default) returns an image sized by width and height. "pdf" returns the page as an A4 portrait vector PDF with selectable, searchable text and automatic pagination; width, height, dpi, fullpage and selector are ignored. Use "pdf" to archive a page or produce a printable record. Use "png" for anything displayed at fixed pixel dimensions.

fullpage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels (1-5000). Defaults to 1080.

selector.description: Capture only the element matching this CSS selector.

url.description: The fully-qualified URL of the page to capture (https://...).

wait_for_selector.description: Wait until this CSS selector is present before capturing.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels (1-5000). Defaults to 1920.

name: screenshot-url
